meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: Claude 会扫描项目里没人引用的代码,用 LSP 引用检查确认后,按文件分批交给并行子代理删除,每批单独 git 提交,最后跑类型检查、测试和构建并给出删除汇总清单。
howto.when: 当你提到「remove dead code」「dead code」「cleanup」等关键词时触发;也可以指定文件、目录或符号名来缩小扫描范围。

say.text: 扫描整个项目,找出没被引用的代码
只清理 src/utils 目录下的死代码
say.note: 把扫描范围限定在该目录

say.text: 删掉 src/foo.ts:42 那个没人用的函数
say.note: 会用 LSP 复核后单独提交

howto.what_en: Claude scans for unreferenced code, confirms candidates with LSP reference checks, splits removals into per-file batches run by parallel agents, commits each separately, then runs typecheck, tests and build and reports a summary.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "remove dead code", "dead code" or "cleanup"; you can also name a file, directory or symbol to narrow the scan.

say_en.text: Scan the whole project for unreferenced code
Only clean up dead code in src/utils
say_en.note: narrows the scan to that directory

say_en.text: Remove the unused function at src/foo.ts:42
